actionConfiguration.body:
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lidor_leads_view
   WHERE masleka_date = '{{moment(_DatePicker_Start.selectedDate).format("YYYY-MM-DD")}}'::date
     AND touched_by_lidor = TRUE) AS "מסלקות_הוזמנו",

  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lidor_leads_view
   WHERE lidor_status = 'נקבעה פגישה'
     AND update_date = '{{moment(_DatePicker_Start.selectedDate).format("YYYY-MM-DD")}}'::date
     AND touched_by_lidor = TRUE) AS "פגישות_נקבעו",

  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lidor_leads_view
   WHERE close_date = '{{moment(_DatePicker_Start.selectedDate).format("YYYY-MM-DD")}}'::date
     AND touched_by_lidor = TRUE) AS "סגירות",

  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(closing_amount), 0) FROM lidor_leads_view
   WHERE close_date = '{{moment(_DatePicker_Start.selectedDate).format("YYYY-MM-DD")}}'::date
     AND touched_by_lidor = TRUE) AS "סכום_סגירות",

  (SELECT
     CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0
          ELSE ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE meeting_held = 'כן')
                      / COUNT(*), 1)
     END
   FROM lidor_leads_view
   WHERE touched_by_lidor = TRUE
     AND DATE_TRUNC('month', meeting_date)
         = DATE_TRUNC('month', '{{moment(_DatePicker_Start.selectedDate).format("YYYY-MM-DD")}}'::timestamp)
     AND meeting_date::date <= '{{moment(_DatePicker_Start.selectedDate).format("YYYY-MM-DD")}}'::date
  ) AS "אחוז_פגישות_מתקיימות_החודש";
